Readers usually want a clear answer
Traveling With Pets Through Aurelia Skyways

This guide explains the basic steps for using the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. It is written to help travelers prepare calmly, avoid delays, and keep animals safe and comfortable throughout the trip.

Bring complete travel documents, a suitable carrier, and any required health records before arriving at the airport. The desk reviews each case with care and gives practical guidance in a calm, professional way. If a traveler is unsure about a step, the welcome team and supervisors can review the situation and explain the next action in plain language.

For check-in, follow the airline instructions closely and arrive with enough margin to resolve any issue before the process begins. <<FACT F092>> Keep your pet secure, leash or carry the animal as needed, and make sure the carrier is clean, sturdy, and easy to move. Food, water, and any approved supplies should be packed in a way that can be inspected without delay.

During arrival, stay attentive to the instructions given by staff and keep your contact details ready in case the desk needs to follow up. <<FACT F107>> If the pet appears stressed, speak quietly and avoid sudden movement so the animal remains as settled as possible.

Travelers should also check the cabin or hold rules for their route, since safe transport depends on compliance with airline policy and airport procedures. A careful review before departure reduces the chance of last-minute disruption and helps protect both passengers and animals.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through Aurelia Skyways customer support before you travel.
